text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Six NGED solar farms, daylight hours, September 2019 to June 2026. ERA5: ECMWF's reanalysis of past weather. CAMS: satellite irradiance service. Purple dot: the mean absolute error of that variable set (% of capacity; smaller is better). Hollow diamond: the error of the row below, which is the zero of this row's step. Thin purple line on G0: 95% interval of G0's own error. Orange line on every other row: 95% interval of that step alone, from resampling whole months, drawn from the diamond. An orange line is not the uncertainty of its dot's position. A minus sign in the right column means the error fell. A step depends on the order in which the groups were added. A variable set is the list of inputs the XGBoost model is given. G0: sun position, ERA5 solar radiation (ssrd), and air temperature (t2m). Each group adds to the one before. G1: total cloud cover. G2: low, mid, and high cloud cover. G3: clear-sky radiation. G4: cloud water and cloud base height. G5: direct beam. G6: wind and thermal radiation. G7: humidity and haze. G8: snow and albedo. G9 (the full set): all other ERA5 variables. The G1 step was planned in advance. Every other step is exploratory and not corrected for multiple comparisons.'
text.tspan: Six NGED solar farms, daylight hours, September 2019 to June 2026. ERA5: ECMWF's reanalysis of past weather. CAMS:
Purple dot: the mean absolute error of that variable set (% of capacity; smaller is better).
Hollow diamond: the error of the row below, which is the zero of this row's step.
Thin purple line on G0: 95% interval of G0's own error. Orange line on every other row: 95% interval of that step
alone, from resampling whole months, drawn from the diamond. An orange line is not the uncertainty of its dot's
A minus sign in the right column means the error fell. A step depends on the order in which the groups were added.
A variable set is the list of inputs the XGBoost model is given. G0: sun position, ERA5 solar
radiation (ssrd), and air temperature (t2m). Each group adds to the one before.
G1: total cloud cover. G2: low, mid, and high cloud cover. G3: clear-sky radiation.
G4: cloud water and cloud base height. G5: direct beam. G6: wind and thermal radiation.
G7: humidity and haze. G8: snow and albedo. G9 (the full set): all other ERA5 variables.
The G1 step was planned in advance. Every other step is exploratory and not corrected for multiple comparisons.
